obligations.title: Deliver the mainframe assessment report by 12 December 2026.
Provide timely access to personnel, systems, documentation and information the Supplier reasonably requires.
Correct notified non-conformities in a Deliverable promptly at no extra charge and resubmit it.
Comply with the Customer's site, security and change-control policies notified in writing.
Process personal data only on the Customer's documented instructions and apply appropriate technical and organisational security measures.
Notify the Customer without undue delay on becoming aware of a personal data breach.
Return or securely delete personal data at the Customer's election on termination or expiry.
Promptly deliver all completed and work-in-progress Deliverables on expiry or termination.
